pages.text: You are small, and slow, and have no fangs worth showing. You can still be alarming.$(br2)Press $(k:hominin_evolution.threat_display) - or, with nothing in your hands, $(k:sneak) and $(k:use) at the air: call, and leap, and look bigger than you are.

With a branch or a stone in hand, the same gesture throws it. Something that hurts from a distance is a far better argument than noise.$(br2)Go and pick it up again afterwards. Good stones are not so easy to come by.
